---
name: sample-notes
description: Sample user skill for the sync tests. Keeps a short list of notes in NOTES.md. Triggers: 'sample notes'.
---

# Sample notes

1. Read NOTES.md in the current folder. If it does not exist, create it with the heading `# Notes`.
2. Add the note the user gives as one bullet line at the end.
3. Show the last five bullet lines.
